site.name: Nova Gen
site.description: Nova Gen is a self-driven African technology community where members build, review, and grow together through bi-weekly challenges, project reviews, and shared opportunities.

philosophy.quote: We provide the structure. The members create the activity.
philosophy.note: Nova Gen is a working community where members build, share progress, review one another's work, and pass opportunities along.

principles.title: Growth Through Community
principles.body: Members learn by building alongside one another and sharing what they learn.

principles.title: Collaboration Over Isolation
principles.body: Members ask for feedback, review one another's work, and find people to build with.

principles.title: Opportunities Through Connection
principles.body: Jobs, leads, events, and collaborations move through the community.

ecosystem.title: Bi-Weekly Challenges
ecosystem.body: A new brief gives members a shared project to build and review every two weeks.

ecosystem.title: Project Reviews
ecosystem.body: Members share work in progress and get useful feedback from the community.

ecosystem.title: Jobs & Opportunities
ecosystem.body: Members share roles, internships, contracts, and useful leads.

ecosystem.title: Events & Resources
ecosystem.body: Sessions, workshops, and resources help members keep learning.

ecosystem.title: Community Connections
ecosystem.body: Introductions and shared interests help members find people to build with.

ecosystem.title: Collaboration & Building
ecosystem.body: Members work together on products, prototypes, and creative projects.

channels.name: General Chat
channels.body: Introductions, questions, and everyday community conversation.

channels.name: Jobs & Leads
channels.body: Roles, contracts, and useful leads shared by members.

channels.name: Events & Resources
channels.body: Upcoming sessions and useful resources in one place.

channels.name: Announcements
channels.body: Updates from the community team, including challenge briefs and deadlines.

channels.name: Content Creators
channels.body: Writers, designers, and video makers share the community's work.

channels.name: Project Reviews
channels.body: Share work in progress and receive feedback from other members.

values.title: Intentionality
values.body: Members choose what they work on and show up for it.

values.title: Access
values.body: Opportunity should not depend on which room you already got into.

values.title: Excellence
values.body: Thoughtful review helps members improve their work.

values.title: Community
values.body: The group's progress matters more than any single member's highlight.

values.title: Curiosity
values.body: Questions are welcome at every level.

values.title: Authenticity
values.body: Members share real work, honest gaps, and steady progress.

values.title: Global Mindset
values.body: African by origin, building for a global stage.

values.title: Reciprocity
values.body: Members give back to the next person what they learn here.

steps.title: The challenge is posted
steps.body: A new challenge brief is shared in the community. Members post what they plan to build.

steps.title: Share progress and get reviews
steps.body: Members share updates in the group, ask for reviews, and get feedback from other builders.

steps.title: Make improvements
steps.body: Use the feedback to make corrections and prepare the final submission.

steps.title: Submit the finished work
steps.body: Members submit their final work to the community.

steps.title: Share the work on X
steps.body: The community comes together to share the work on the Nova Gen X account.
